name: Talanga Open 2022
information:
Talanga Open 2022 es una competencia que se realizara a 1 hora de la capital de Honduras, siendo apoyada por la alcaldia municipal del municipio de Talanga. Sera un evento abierto a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Talanga Open 2022 is a competition that will take place 1 hour from the capital of Honduras, being supported by the municipal mayor of the municipality of Talanga. It will be an event open to competitors of any nationality.
